milestones.title: The authorizing official accepts the limit, or per-person volume keys are designed

remediation: One LUKS class key encrypts every workspace volume, so a departed person's volume cannot be erased by destroying its own key; the disks follow your organization's media handling. Record the authorizing official's acceptance of this limit, or design per-person volume keys.
title: Removing a workspace volume does not cryptographically erase it
